title: Request a conversation
lede: Leave your name and a few times that suit you. Sarvakali confirms the meeting or suggests another time, and the Google Meet link arrives by email.
assurance: Nothing about your situation is asked for here. Share as much or as little as you like when you meet.

form.name: Your name
form.emailHint: The meeting invitation is sent here.
form.keptHint: These go with your request. Remove any you would rather not mention.
form.topic: What you would like to talk about
form.privacy: We use your name, email and phone only to arrange this conversation. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

done.title: Request received
done.text: Sarvakali will confirm your time, or suggest another, by email.
